crises.name: Sudan
crises.top: USG Tom Fletcher pressed the Council for unimpeded access across front lines.

briefings.speaker: OCHA Spokesperson
briefings.text: Access to El Fasher remains severely constrained; convoys have been delayed for over two weeks.

briefings.speaker: OCHA Spokesperson
briefings.text: 3.2 million people newly displaced since the escalation began, per latest cluster figures.

leadership.speaker: USG Tom Fletcher
leadership.text: Called on all parties to allow unimpeded humanitarian access across front lines.

sc.speaker: United Kingdom
sc.text: Urged the Council to press for a humanitarian pause to allow aid corridors to reopen.

sc.speaker: Sierra Leone
sc.text: Welcomed OCHA's briefing and called for sustained funding of the Sudan HRP.

onOcha.text: Thanked OCHA for its briefing and echoed its call for a humanitarian pause.
Welcomed OCHA's briefing and called on donors to fully fund its Sudan appeal.
Questioned OCHA's figures on access denials, calling for independent verification.

crises.top: ERC Tom Fletcher told the Council the response is operating under "impossible constraints."

briefings.speaker: OCHA Spokesperson
briefings.text: Fuel shortages are affecting hospital generators across the strip.

briefings.speaker: OCHA Spokesperson
briefings.text: Aid distribution points report continued access denials at several crossings.

leadership.speaker: ERC Tom Fletcher
leadership.text: Told the Council that the humanitarian response is operating under 'impossible constraints.'

sc.speaker: France
sc.text: Called for immediate and sustained humanitarian access in line with international law.

sc.speaker: Algeria
sc.text: Cited OCHA figures on civilian casualties in its statement.

onOcha.text: Backed OCHA's assessment and called for donors to close the funding gap.
Cited OCHA's casualty figures directly in its statement to the Council.
Pressed OCHA to clarify its methodology for the latest displacement estimate.

crises.name: DR Congo

briefings.text: Displacement in North Kivu has passed 2.8 million as clashes continue near Goma.

sc.speaker: Democratic Republic of Congo
sc.text: Requested renewed Council attention to the humanitarian toll of the conflict.

onOcha.text: Thanked OCHA for its coordination role and requested expanded field presence.
